info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Borax Pendant Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Borax Pendant Detail Management API allows users to efficiently manage and create detailed entries for borax pendant items in the catalog. This endpoint is designed for product managers and developers looking to enhance their inventory with accurate product information. Typical operations include defining specifications, adding attributes, and ensuring data integrity for borax pendant products. By leveraging this API, businesses can streamline their product catalog operations and improve user experience with comprehensive details.

post.summary: Create details for a borax pendant.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create new details for a borax pendant. You need to provide the necessary information in the request body to successfully create the details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit the details for a new borax pendant. It must contain all required fields as specified in the schema, ensuring that the provided information meets the necessary criteria for processing.
